author: Дмитрий Лукашов
scope: Standalone offline process kit and Python CLI that audits a supplied sales handoff packet, its exact-version acknowledgement and a declared CRM snapshot. Reports local consistency findings for human review. No CRM API, writes, messaging, source retrieval, identity authentication, generated acceptance, customer consent or payment verification; not a full customer lifecycle engine.
origin: Original handoff checker, bilingual workflow/documentation and invented teaching fixture prepared for this open-module task in November 2026 with AI assistance. Install/uninstall helpers adapt the same author's public MIT Presentation Kit v0.1.0 and Company Knowledge Kit v0.1.1 helpers; authorship and license retained. No private core, client export, contact list, transcript, proprietary process document or third-party skill collection copied.
output_format: JSON review queue with explicit observation time, supplied-snapshot metadata, input SHA-256 and exact packet fingerprints

input_limits.max_snapshot_age_hours: Explicit user-selected integer from 1 to 168; not a universal CRM standard.
input_limits.schema: Run schema for precise bounded fields and collections; this is not a universal vendor-export format.

installer_support: POSIX-only explicit-prefix launcher; Windows runs source CLI through Python. Configured CI and actual native-host results are separate evidence.

search_intent.ru: проверка передачи сделки в CRM; подтверждение версии пакета сделки; аудит ответственного этапа и следующего шага
search_intent.en: offline CRM sales handoff audit; exact packet acknowledgement; RevOps owner stage and next-step review

suggested_description: Audit a sales handoff against its exact acknowledged packet and a supplied CRM snapshot. Offline Python CLI, review queue and bilingual workflow. No CRM writes or model.
